records.summary: Reuters reports Binance's first withdrawal phase began after 06:00 GMT, BTC withdrawals resumed, and XRP is among 15 phase-one assets. Binance reports approximately $6B of aggregate replacement-token purchases and 95% recovery. XRP-specific withdrawal success and XRP-specific acquisition quantities remain unverified.
verified: Reuters article published 2026-11-01 06:49 UTC reports Binance's status page shortly after 06:00 GMT said planned withdrawals had begun; phase one covers 15 cryptoassets including BTC, ETH, XRP and DOGE.
Reuters reports Binance says it covered $6B of stolen cryptocurrencies by using company money to buy replacement tokens; remaining 5% are less-liquid assets.

Reuters reports funding sources named by Binance: SAFU (including a bitcoin reserve), Futures Insurance Fund and corporate treasury; co-CEO Yi He said 50% of SAFU funds would be used and replenished toward $1B.
The public Binance network page at the earlier 07:07:12 UTC capture displayed 06:53:22 AM with timezone undisclosed and a 'No records' table; it exposed no XRP-specific status.
XRP Insights reports 1B XRP released at 00:00:02 UTC, no re-escrow by ledger 108038942 at 05:39 UTC, 30.4B XRP remaining; raw Destination fields remain unverified.
PR #1449 exact-head CI passed 367 tests plus eight subtests and its fail-closed gate passed; PR remains open/draft/unmerged.
PR #1450 archive validator failed on malformed latest archive shard metadata and stale index pointers; its fail-closed gate passed with merging disabled.
unresolved: No successful XRP withdrawal transaction or asset-specific XRP availability row independently observed.
Reuters' $6B replacement-token purchases are aggregate; XRP-specific amount, venue and timing are undisclosed.
Current Binance attacker-wallet balance and post-October 31 outflows remain unknown.
Raw November 1 EscrowFinish Destination fields and subsequent XRP disposition remain unknown.
PR #1450 archive correction has not yet passed exact-head revalidation.
